description:
CHRONOS allows you to schedule SMS message delivery for a specific date and time, without replacing your default messaging app.
== FEATURES ==
SMS Scheduling
• Pick the recipient from your contacts or enter a number manually
• Compose your message and select the scheduled date and time
• Edit or delete a message before it is sent
Status Tracking
• SCHEDULED: awaiting delivery
• SENT: message transmitted successfully
• FAILED: scheduled time elapsed while device was off, or network error
• CANCELLED: deleted before delivery
Message Templates
• Create pre-recorded message templates
• Insert them in one tap when composing
Complete History
• View upcoming messages in the "Upcoming" tab
• Consult past message history in the "History" tab
Reliability
• Messages are automatically rescheduled after device reboot
• If the device was powered off at the scheduled time, the message is marked FAILED (no unexpected late delivery)
Privacy
• Zero data sent over the Internet
• All data remains stored locally on your device
• SMS and Contacts permissions used strictly for core functionality
This app is free and open source (GPLv3 license).
